title: HullQ IdentityAlias v0.1
description: An entity-scoped alias record with stable identity. Aliases are scoped to the entity they name; a Brand alias must not be stored as an Organization alias and vice versa. Alias identity must not depend on array position.

id.description: Stable opaque alias ID within the entity scope.

alias_class.description: Normative alias class from IDENTITY_MODEL.v0.2 Section 4.

name.description: Alias display string. Preserved byte-for-byte; normalization must not be applied here.

notes.description: Optional clarifying note about this alias.
